subject: Hash HyperLogLog elements with a size_t length (#5132)
reason: The change only widens MurmurHash64A's length parameter from int to size_t. Its sole command path is PFADD, which hashes each element using sdslen as the length. The result differs between the two builds only for a single element of 2^31 bytes (2 GiB) or larger, where the old signed int overflowed negative and caused an out-of-bounds read; for every element below that threshold both builds hash identically and produce identical replies. Triggering the fixed path requires embedding a >=2 GiB single argument (a large-memory case), which cannot be expressed within the scenario/experiment size lim
